paite: Akum kuana, akha sawmna, huai kha, ani sawm ni in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
heading: Sa Uina Bel
english: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, tuni ngei, hiai ni min ngei gelhkhia in. Hiai ni ngei in Babulon kumpipa'n Jerusalem ahong sual pan hi.
english: “Son of man, write the name of the day, this same day. The king of Babylon drew close to Jerusalem this same day.

paite: Huan helhat Inkote kiang ah gentehna thu gen inla, akiang uah, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: Utter a parable to the rebellious house, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Put the cauldron on the fire. Put it on, and also pour water into it.

paite: "Sa uina bel suang inla, suang nilouh inla, asung ah tui sung in; sabakte kha inla, asa hoih tengteng, apheite, aliangte, aguhbawk hoih tata in hihdim in.
english: Gather its pieces into it, even every good piece: the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the choice bones.

paite: Ganhonte lak a ahoih tata la inla, anuai ah singkhuah khul ek inla, sou bolhbolh hen; ahi, aguhbomte ki-ui hen."
english: Take the choice of the flock, and also a pile of wood for the bones under the cauldron. Make it boil well. Yes, let its bones be boiled within it.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi, sa uina bel, asung kanggem, agem dai ngei nai lou tung agik hi! Tel tuan lou in, asa bak khatkhat in thuk in.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city, to the cauldron whose rust is in it, and whose rust hasn’t gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece without casting lots for it.

paite: Asisan suah amah tung ah a-om a, leivui vuhtheihna dia lei a sunbuak gen tak louh, suangpi keu tung ah asungbo zawta hi.
english: “‘“For the blood she shed is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it with dust.

paite: Phu la ding a hehna ahong kisaktheihna ding in vuh louh in asisan suah suangpi keu tung ah ka sung ahi."
english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sisan suah hat khopi tung agik hi! Kei mahmah in ka vum venvon ding.
english: “‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.

paite: Singtum sevum venvon unla, mei chihsa unla, sate ui min unla, satui chiktak in, aguhte leng kangmang hen.
english: Heap on the wood. Make the fire hot. Boil the meat well. Make the broth thick, and let the bones be burned.

paite: Huchi in bel avuak in meivu tung ah suan hi nilouh henla, ahong sa ding a, adal ahong am ding a, anitna ahong zulmang ding, akangkhem akatmang theihna ding in.
english: Then set it empty on its coals, that it may be hot, and its bronze may burn, and that its filthiness may be molten in it, that its rust may be consumed.

paite: Chimtak khop a sual in leng akangkhem asiang tuan kei a, mei in leng akangsiang sam kei hi.
english: She is weary with toil; yet her great rust, rust by fire, doesn’t leave her.

paite: Na nitna hukna ahi a, ka hon khuah a, na sian tuan louh ziak in na tung ah ka hehna ka lungdamsak mateng chik mah chiang in na nitna a kipan khuahsiang na hi nawnta kei ding hi.
english: “‘“In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you and you weren’t cleansed, you won’t be cleansed from your filthiness any more, until I have caused my wrath toward you to rest.

paite: Kei TOUPA'N ka chita ahi, ahong tung mahmah ding, ke'n ka hih ding, ka nungkin kei ding a, ka hawi sam kei ding a, ka lunghei sam kei ding; na omdante leh na thilhih bang zel in vai ahon hawmsak ding uh, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Zawlneipa Zi Sihna
english: Also Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, ngai in, thakhat in na mittaina pen ka hon laksak ding a, na suun ding ahi kei dia, na kah ding leng ahi sam kei, na khitui leng akiak ding ahi kei hi.
english: “Son of man, behold, I will take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, neither shall your tears run down.

paite: Asim in thum inla, misi suunna nei ke'n, na dial khim inla, na khedap bun inla, na muk hum ke'nla, mite an leng ne ke'n," achi hi.
english: Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet. Don’t cover your lips, and don’t eat mourner’s bread.”

paite: Huchi in zingsang lam in mipite kiang ah thu ka gen a, nitaklam in ka zi asi maimah a; zingsang lam in ahon thupiak bang in ka hih hi.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. So I did in the morning as I was commanded.

paite: Mite'n ka kiang ah, hichibang na thilhihte kou ding in bang ahia ahih na hon hilh kei dia hia? achi uhi.
english: The people asked me, “Won’t you tell us what these things mean to us, that you act like this?”

paite: Huchi in ke'n akiang uah, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a.
english: Then I said to them, “Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: Israel inkote kiang ah gen inla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai un, ka mun siangthou, na hatna suan pen uh, na mittaina pen uh, na deihlam pen uh ka hihnin ding hi; na tanute uh; na tapate uh, nunglam a na nutsiatte uh namsau in apuk ding uh.
english: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pities; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.

paite: Ka hih bang geih in na hih tei ding uhi; na muk uh na hum kei ding ua, mite an leng na ne sam kei ding uh.
english: You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.

paite: Na dialte uh leng na khim ding ua, na khedap uh na bun ding ua; na suun kei ding ua, na kap sam kei ding ua, na thulimlouhnate uah na mangthang ding ua, na kikahtuah ding uhi.
english: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You won’t mourn or weep; but you will pine away in your iniquities, and moan one toward another.

paite: Hichibang in Ezekiel, nou a ding in etsakna ahi ding a, ahihdan bang zel in na hih ding uh ahi; hiai ahong tun hun chiang in Toupa PATHIAN ka hi chih na thei ding uh, chi ahi, ka chi hi.
english: Thus Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”’”

paite: "Huan nang mihing tapa, amau a kipan ahatnate uh, athupi kipahnate uh, amit tainapente uh, alunglutna pente uh, atanu uleh atapate uh ka lakmang ni chiang in,
english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

paite: huai ni mahmah chiang in na kiang ah taikhemi hong pai in, ahong theisak kei ding ua hia?
english: that in that day he who escapes will come to you, to cause you to hear it with your ears?

paite: Huai ni chiang in taikhemi kiang ah na kam na ka ding a, akiang ah thu na gen ding a, na dai maimah kei ding; huchi in amaute a ding in etsakna na hi ding a; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," achi hi.
english: In that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped, and you will speak and be no more mute. So you will be a sign to them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”
